name: MARI
note: Global events and experiences company founded by Ariel Emanuel (Founder and Principal Investor), with Mark Shapiro as Principal Investor and Board Member; portfolio includes the Miami and Madrid Open tennis tournaments, Frieze, Barrett-Jackson and TodayTix Group. The Guardian (20 Oct 2025, theguardian.com/business/2025/oct/20/secret-cinema-company-is-bought-by-hollywood-power-broker) reports Mari is backed by Apollo Global Management and RedBird Capital Partners.
